--- title: "Binomial random-intercept scale checks and performance" jupyter: python3 --- phit's `fit_mixed_logistic_matrix()`, R lme4 `glmer()`, and an independent Python/SciPy implementation fit the same Laplace marginal ML model. The Python worker is phit's likelihood and optimizer reference. It is not statsmodels' Bayesian mixed-model estimator or an optimized Python GLMM package. ## Methods | Item | Setting | | --- | --- | | Workloads | 1,000, 10,000, and 100,000 rows; 50 groups; 3 fixed coefficients; one random intercept; Laplace approximation | | Data | Shared deterministic binary outcomes with correlated study and practice predictors | | Machine | AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX virtual machine, 2 cores, 7.8 GiB, Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (x86_64) | | Threads | Pinned to 1 | | Repetitions | One warm-up, then three timed fits per worker | | Timed | One complete fit with inference and observation-length outputs | | Excluded | Compact output sampling and JSON serialization | | Memory | Peak RSS of the whole worker process, from `peakmem` ([bench/peakmem.c](https://github.com/phpstats/phit/blob/main/bench/peakmem.c)) | ## Timing boundaries and correctness PHP times the complete native call, including conversion and all returned inference/observation arrays. R/Python materialize covariance, standard errors, conditional modes and full fixed/conditional fitted values and residuals. Process time includes startup, CSV load, warm-up and all timed fits. A report is written only after coefficients, covariance/standard errors, group SD/modes, normalized likelihood and common observation samples agree. Likelihood tolerance is absolute 1e-6 plus relative 1e-8; inference uses absolute 2e-5 plus relative 2e-3; estimates use absolute 2e-5 plus relative 2e-4. Group modes use absolute 5e-5 because large-sample flat-profile optimization produced shifts around 2e-5 in modes near zero; relative error there is not informative. These tolerances apply to phit against R. The SciPy reference is checked against R as a peer, with group modes at absolute 2e-4, because its independent optimizer stops at a slightly different point on the same flat profile. The installed lme4 version disables derivative checks automatically at large n. The benchmark explicitly enables the final joint Hessian. Its initial BOBYQA run also stopped short on the 10,000-row case; an R-only restart from that fit, with rhobeg=0.001 and nAGQ0initStep=FALSE, resolved it. **Both R stages are included in its fit time.** The report records these controls, versions and data/binary hashes. Native estimates never seed the R worker. ## Results ::: {#a6801384 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from pathlib import Path import json import pandas as pd from IPython.display import display ROOT=next(p for p in [Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents] if (p/'Cargo.toml').exists()) report=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/logistic-mixed-results.json').read_text()) ORDER=['R','SciPy reference','PHP'] rows=[] for case in report['cases']: for label in ORDER: r=case['implementations'][label] rows.append(dict(observations=case['n'],groups=case['n_groups'],implementation=label, median_fit_seconds=r['median_fit_seconds'],CSV_load_seconds=r['load_seconds'], whole_process_seconds=r['process_seconds'], peak_process_RSS_MiB=r['peak_rss_bytes']/2**20 if r['peak_rss_bytes'] else None, numerical_agreement=case['agreement_passed'])) table=pd.DataFrame(rows);display(table) print('Machine:',report.get('cpu'),report['platform']) print('Threads:',report['thread_environment']) print('Versions:',{name:report['cases'][0]['implementations'][name]['version'] for name in ORDER}) import subprocess,os subprocess.run([os.environ.get('RSCRIPT','Rscript'),str(ROOT/'docs/figures/render.R'),'logistic-mixed'],check=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}

They do not benchmark 61-node integration, random slopes or multiple grouping terms. A larger dataset does not by itself establish approximation accuracy; see the [independent integration checks](../notebooks/logistic-mixed-verification.qmd). The full measurements and errors are in the [saved report](logistic-mixed-results.json). ## Reproduction ```sh cargo build -p phit --release --locked PHP=/opt/homebrew/bin/php .context/notebooks-venv/bin/python \ tests/benchmarks/run-logistic-mixed.py --sizes 1000,10000,100000 --repeats 3 ``` Use a matching PHP and php-config, and `.so` on Linux.
